name: Wobblewood Park
summary:
🏁 Kart Racing is open!
Race animal drivers on eight courses (three of them easy), picked from a map board.
- Right trigger to go, left trigger to brake. Turn and squeeze the brake lightly to drift.
- Drifting fills a bar and earns boosters. Tuck in behind another kart for a slipstream.
- Speed races, and item races with water balloons, fireworks, bubbles, umbrellas and magnets.
- Steer with a real wheel or the thumbstick. Top speed 20-80 km/h, 2 to 6 rivals, four skill levels.
🎡 The amusement park
